content.name: Weapon Mastery
entries: Your training with weapons allows you to use the {@variantrule weapon mastery properties|SRD52|mastery properties} of two kinds of {@filter weapons|items|type=simple weapon;martial weapon} of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as {@item Longbow|SRD52|Longbows} and {@item Shortsword|SRD52|Shortswords}.

Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose. For example, you could switch to using the {@variantrule weapon mastery properties|SRD52|mastery properties} of {@item Scimitar|SRD52|Scimitars} and {@item Longsword|SRD52|Longswords}.
